id: title:andrewm4894:only use activity only reviewer fallback as a last resort

review.posthog_relevance: This chunk implements a preference in the signals backend to exclude inactive, activity-only candidates when a live weighted candidate exists, and its corresponding tests. This could support PostHog's internal reviewer selection or candidate ranking mechanisms, potentially improving the quality of ranked results.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F1.H1 adds a specific check to exclude activity-only candidates, while P1.F2.H2 tests the resulting ranking behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded change to candidate selection and ranking behavior.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is not explicitly identified as belonging to PostHog's public repository; the relevance is inferred from the description of the signals backend and candidate ranking, which could be an internal or private component. No adoption or production impact is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains both implementation and test changes. P1.F1.H1 shows the implementation of a new activity-based ranking preference. P1.F2.H1, P1.F2.H2, P1.F2.H3 show corresponding test assertions. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a check to exclude activity-only candidates if a weighted candidate is still active, and filters scores to only include weighted candidates if any are active.
observations.code_quote: return activity is not None and activity.days_since_last_commit < ACTIVITY_WINDOW_DAYS
